BehaviorContextUpdateRequest.title: BehaviorContextUpdateRequest
BehaviorContextUpdateRequest.description: One owner answer that can materially refine a behavior result.

ContextOption.title: ContextOption
ContextOption.description:
One plain-language answer that really answers ``context_question``.

The client sends only ``id``. The server resolves the exact label already
shown to the owner, so arbitrary or hidden client text never enters the
reasoner.

DigestiveContextUpdateRequest.title: DigestiveContextUpdateRequest
DigestiveContextUpdateRequest.description: Sparse owner-confirmed context; omitted answers remain unknown.

FeedingPeriodUpdate.title: FeedingPeriodUpdate
FeedingPeriodUpdate.description: Update the active period in place. A quantity change is not a food change.

FoodManualCreateRequest.title: FoodManualCreateRequest
FoodManualCreateRequest.description: Owner-entered food, confirmed at creation without a label photo.

FoodVerifyRequest.title: FoodVerifyRequest
FoodVerifyRequest.description: Only user-verified fields become durable data (sez. 20.1).

IntentCode.title: IntentCode
IntentCode.description:
Initial closed intent taxonomy (sez. 16.2).

Closed allowlist: provider output outside this set is schema-invalid.

LifestylePreferences.title: LifestylePreferences
LifestylePreferences.description: Typed owner-reported preferences (closed key set, extra="forbid").

LifestyleRoutine.title: LifestyleRoutine
LifestyleRoutine.description:
Typed owner-reported daily routine.

Closed key set with bounds (extra="forbid"): the API is the enforcement
point, since the DB column stays jsonb. `null` clears a previously
reported value. Keys match the mobile client's snake_case payload
(activity, sleep, time_alone, social, enrichment) plus quantified fields.

SafetyFlag.title: SafetyFlag
SafetyFlag.description:
Structured flags consumed by the deterministic copy layer (sez. 16.3).
Generated text may never downgrade a safety flag (sez. 19.3).

SignalCategory.title: SignalCategory
SignalCategory.description: Consumer-safe acoustic signal categories for Dogly Signals.

TodayVsUsual.title: TodayVsUsual
TodayVsUsual.description:
Owner-reported daily check-in: today compared with this dog's usual.

`off` is a high-value OWNER-REPORTED CHANGE for the reasoner. `soft`
clears a previous off-day so yesterday's concern does not linger.
